title: Practice 1: Numerals, nouns and adjectives together

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.prompt: Tom was a prisoner of war for three years.
exercises.why: After «три» the noun is genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: On average, how many times per minute does a person blink?
exercises.ru: Сколько ___ в минуту в среднем моргает человек?
exercises.why: «If the number ends in 2, 3 or 4 use the genitive singular … If the number ends in 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 0 or -надцать use the genitive plural.» Много, мало, сколько, несколько also take the genitive. — Wikibooks, «Genitive case».
The number agrees in case with the noun: dative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
